note: Owner 2026-11-10: the tiara redrawn 'more pronounced' and the flower ring with bigger flowers (both must read at a distance: docs/avatar-plan.md, headwear art direction); two outfits per body: f adventurer and court gown, m noble doublet and scholar's robe (the owner's picks of six recommended). One candidate each.

hat-f-tiara.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture). The attached close-up on magenta is the HEAD AND SHOULDERS of a BASE BODY of this game: a young woman, bald, in a tan undershift. Redraw that close-up EXACTLY as it is, pixel for pixel: the same bald head at the same size and position, the same face, eyes, brows, ears, neck, shoulders and undershift, changing NOTHING, and add ONLY her HEADWEAR: a bold SILVER TIARA: a broad band of bright silver, clearly thicker than a finger, rising at the front to a tall rounded peak, set with ONE large sky-blue gem at the peak and one smaller sky-blue gem on each side of it, with a dark outline; it sits on the top front of the head above the brow. It must READ AT A DISTANCE, when the whole figure is drawn very small: a few LARGE, bold, simple shapes with strong contrast against skin and hair, never fine or delicate detail. It is SYMMETRICAL and its centre sits exactly on the centre line of the face, straight above the nose. It is worn over HAIR in the game, so draw it a little WIDER than the bald head: it stands slightly proud of the scalp at both sides; it is FULL COLOUR (not grey), worn naturally at head size; the face, the eyes and the brows stay fully visible and unchanged. Everything that is not the added part stays identical. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere that is not the drawing: no gradient, no texture, no scene, no frame, no text; never pink, never magenta, never purple on the drawing itself.
hat-f-tiara.extract: key, align, diff --open 1 --defringe --min 0.02 --fill --faceclear female --skinclear 8, seat --axis top (centre onto the nose line)  [superseded by parts-r7]
